full_prompt_en: A square painterly illustration places an anthropomorphic blue wolf in a dark maroon coat on the left side of a high, dimly lit terrace. Its long muzzle points toward the center, and a thin white trail of smoke curls from the face into the red-orange sky. One paw lifts near its chest. The figure sits with one bent leg beside a narrow table that carries several brown bottles and small drinking glasses. In front of the table, an open book rests on a round barrel top, its pale pages catching the remaining light. Beyond this intimate foreground, blocky blue buildings recede across the lower half of the scene. A tall, pointed tower rises on the right edge, with smaller chimneys and rooftops cutting into the glow below. A pale circular moon appears through a dusty ochre area near the upper right. Much of the center is occupied by a broad, irregular column of yellow and orange cloud that rises against a deeper red field. The city and the seated body are built from angular silhouettes and layered planes rather than precise perspective. Dense blue and teal areas anchor the lower and side edges, while warm color spreads across the upper and middle space. The surface shows soft brush scumbles, mottled pigment and grain like printed paper. Contours shift between crisp dark outlines around the wolf and more dissolved edges in the luminous cloud. The strong light is carried by warm color, not by a modeled beam; cool shadows remain broad and flat beneath it. A quiet pause at the table contrasts with the sweeping movement of the sky. The whole frame holds a theatrical, dreamlike balance between a small private scene and a vast burning atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画感插画把穿深栗色外套的拟人化蓝狼放在左侧昏暗的高处露台上。细长的吻部指向中央，一缕纤细白烟从面前卷进红橙色天空。一只爪子抬在胸前。它屈起一条腿坐在窄桌旁，桌上有几只棕色瓶子和小酒杯。桌前一本摊开的书放在圆形木桶顶部，浅色书页承接余光。越过这块亲近的前景，成块蓝色建筑在画面下半部退远。右缘竖起尖顶高塔，较矮的烟囱和屋顶从下方切入亮光。右上附近一轮浅色圆月透过灰赭区域显现。中央很大一部分被宽阔而不规则的黄橙云柱占据，它在更深的红色域前向上升起。城市和坐姿身体由棱角剪影与叠置平面构成，而不是精确透视。浓厚蓝色和青绿色压住下缘与侧缘，暖色则铺展到上方和中间。表面有柔软的擦扫笔痕、斑驳颜料和近似印刷纸面的颗粒。轮廓在蓝狼周围的清晰暗线与明亮云层里散开的边缘之间变化。强光由暖色承担，并非一束经过塑形的光；下方冷阴影保持宽大而平坦。桌边的短暂静止与天空的奔涌相对。整幅画在小小私人场景与广阔燃烧般的空气之间形成戏剧化、梦境般的平衡。
style_prompt_en: The image has a painterly illustration surface with mottled pigment, soft scumbled strokes and a fine printed-paper grain. Large warm fields of red, orange, ochre and pale yellow press against dense teal and blue masses, making color area the main source of light. Angular dark silhouettes establish firm foreground anchors while layered flat planes suggest depth with only loose perspective. Edges alternate between ink-dark clarity and hazy diffusion where bright color spreads into neighboring tones. A vertical warm surge is balanced by cooler weight along the lower and lateral edges. Small pale accents punctuate the broad color fields without dissolving their simplicity. The lighting feels theatrical and internal to the pigment: warm passages glow, and cool passages retain broad, quiet shadow. The composition mixes intimate scale with an expansive atmospheric field, allowing a still focal cluster to sit inside larger sweeping motion. Visible grain and uneven paint keep the image tactile and slightly worn.
style_prompt_zh: 图像呈现绘画插画表面，颜料斑驳、擦扫笔痕柔软，并带有细密的印刷纸面颗粒。大片红、橙、赭与浅黄暖色压向浓密青绿和蓝色团块，使色彩面积成为主要光源。棱角分明的深色剪影固定前景，叠置的平面仅以松散透视暗示纵深。边缘在墨黑般的清晰度与亮色向邻近色调扩散的朦胧感之间转换。纵向暖色涌动由下缘和侧缘较冷的重量平衡。少量浅色强调点落在宽阔色域中，又不破坏其简洁。光线像从颜料内部发出的舞台光：暖色段发亮，冷色段保留宽阔、安静的阴影。构图把亲近尺度与广展的气氛色域结合，使静止的焦点群位于更大范围的流动之中。可见颗粒和不均匀涂色让图像可触且略带磨旧感。
theme_en: An anthropomorphic blue wolf sits at a small table above a city as orange clouds and a pale moon fill the sky
theme_zh: 一只拟人化蓝狼坐在城市上方的小桌旁，橙色云烟与浅色月亮铺满天空
name: Walter Quirt
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
